1. SoMi is not medical care — read this one

SoMi is a general wellbeing app. It is not a medical device, it is not therapy, and it does not provide medical, psychological or other professional advice. Nothing in the Service is intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any condition. SoMi draws on polyvagal-informed somatic practice, which is a framework for organising exercises — not a clinical claim about outcomes in your body.

You use the exercises at your own risk. Consult a qualified healthcare professional before starting if you are pregnant, have a cardiovascular, blood pressure, neck, spine, eye or inner-ear condition, have a seizure disorder, or are being treated for a mental health condition — including trauma, PTSD, or dissociative symptoms. Stop immediately if you feel pain, dizziness, faintness, or distress that does not settle, and seek help.

In an emergency, call your local emergency number. SoMi is not a crisis service, does not monitor what you write, and cannot respond to a request for help. Our full health disclaimer forms part of these Terms.

2. Who can use SoMi

SoMi’s practices may be used by people of all ages. You must be at least 13 years old to create your own account, or older where local law requires a higher minimum age. A parent or guardian may guide a younger child through SoMi using the adult’s own account. If you are under the age of majority where you live, your parent or guardian must agree to these Terms on your behalf. You must not be barred from using the Service under applicable law.

3. Your account

You need an account to use SoMi. You can create one with an email address and password, or with Sign in with Apple. You agree to provide accurate information, to keep your credentials secure, and to tell us promptly at connect@azorean.io if you believe your account has been accessed by someone else. You are responsible for activity that happens under your account.

You can delete your account at any time from inside the app. Deletion is permanent and removes your practice history — see account deletion.
